s1.text:
What changed between Today and Proposed

1. Every control uses the UI font (Today: 365 of 401 render in Arial).
2. IBM Plex Sans + Mono ship with the app instead of falling back per OS.
3. Amber only means warning. Pinned nodes get a blue border, tinted header and pin badge, matched by a blue count chip (see “Nodes in context” below). Agent attention is a thin violet bar on the node header — no halos, no glowing fields.
4. One scale: type 11/12/13/15/20, radii 6/10/14/pill, two shadow levels.
5. Charts sit on the node surface (no black slab) and don't repeat the node title.

Also visible: chrome-less section headings, quiet node headers (⋯ + × on hover), Updates pill clear of nodes, neutral minimap.

s2.text: The old light theme was #F4EFE6 / #EFE7D4 — next to sepia's #F2E7D5 / #EBDCC2 the two were hard to tell apart. Daylight (wave 0) is neutral: #F6F7F9 canvas, white nodes, #DDE2E9 lines.
